name: Halo

hero.sub: Silk presses, knotless braids, installs and colour in Wicker Park. Plus the raw bundles and lace units we trust on the chair, shipped to your door.

welcome.body: Every appointment starts with a proper look at your hair in daylight: what it does, what it hates, and what you actually have time for on a Tuesday morning. Then we build the style around that, not the other way round.

intro: Halo is a hair studio and extensions house in Wicker Park, Chicago. We press, braid, install and colour, and we sell the same raw bundles and lace units we use on the chair.

schedule.note: 24-hour times. null means closed. Monday is 1, Sunday is 0. Booking slots are generated from these.

announce: Now booking new clients for October
Free shipping on hair orders over $150
Free texture consultation with any install

why.d: We look at your hair before we talk about styles. Porosity, density and what it has been through all shape the plan.
Every bundle and unit in the shop is hair we have cut, coloured and pressed ourselves. If it does not hold up on the chair, it does not go on the shelf.
You leave knowing how to wrap it, wash it and sleep on it, with a written routine texted to you the same evening.

demo.text: Demo site. Halo is a fictional salon, built to show what a small-business site can do.
